The '''Bank Foreign Relations Committee''' was an organization under the control of the [[Bank parliament]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Gandle Ott]]. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], the Committee met with a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] delegation from the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'.
